title: Gotta Go Ghast
description: A 1.21.11 datapack that adds 2 enchantments for the ghast harness: Ghastling and Joyride.
body:
A 1.21.11 datapack that adds 2 enchantments for the ghast harness: Ghastling (III) and Joyride (III).

![Ghastling I-III](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/odtLwAGo/images/67ba25a7f3d8e2bd6625d3edfd9e4731d1c64d54.gif)

Each level of Joyride increases the Happy Ghast's flying speed and each level of Ghastling makes the ghast smaller in size (via the scale attribute).

You can also upgrade a harness in the smithing table to make it enchantable in the enchantment table directly for a greater chance of getting what you actually want  

![Upgrading the harness](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/odtLwAGo/images/0676582e389c22d183986a2e582202e0ff0a1284.png)
